annotations.rationale: An admin who hedges and denies nearly as much as she states, which is exactly what a modality-blind reader gets wrong: it is not intermittent, other offices are not known, it is not one person, it is not an expired token, no Conditional Access results, nothing changed, the proxies are said to be healthy. The true signals are the timeout message, several users, Cork only, the empty logs, clear service health and, after the per-proxy test, one proxy timing out and the fix working. The monitoring page that calls both proxies healthy is a tool that disagrees with the engineer's test, so ev07 and ev08 are a source disagreement. The fix in ev10 is stated with a hedge, so it is labelled with medium uncertainty.
